rules: A comparator mismatch is allowed only when an exact stage-scoped entry has status approved.
An open_debt or pending_evidence entry gives a known failure an ID but never turns it into a pass.
A resolved entry preserves the audit trail but is never assigned to a current finding and never suppresses a recurrence.
An unregistered mismatch is a hard failure.
An entry with stale reference evidence cannot suppress a mismatch.

entries.area: retained logical and explicit placement capability
entries.tinygrad: Tensor owns one mutable, deviceful Tensor.uop
entries.polygrad: Default uop_physical is eagerly constructed in C and must match tinygrad Tensor.uop; Polygrad may additionally retain a deviceless logical graph and physical template for Instance, export, and explicit place outside default realization
entries.rationale: Portable logical retention, export, explicit placement, and PolyInstance capture are approved Polygrad superset capabilities; default physical construction and execution are parity surfaces.
entries.approval: AGENTS.md Core Invariants and user-approved logical/physical split

entries.tinygrad: No language-neutral ABI package equivalent
entries.polygrad: PolyInstance owns named bindings, entrypoints, objectives, and package metadata
entries.rationale: PolyInstance is an intentional Polygrad superset feature.

entries.tinygrad: Python Buffer objects own runtime storage
entries.polygrad: PolyCtx owns ctx->buffers residency keyed by BUFFER UOps
entries.rationale: The C ABI requires explicit context-owned residency while preserving tinygrad graph semantics.

entries.tinygrad: PROGRAM may carry SOURCE and BINARY children
entries.polygrad: PROGRAM carries source/program metadata while driver and compiled-binary payloads remain in private runtime-cache entries
entries.rationale: Non-serializable C driver resources are kept outside the immutable UOp arena.
entries.close_when: Revisit only if immutable serializable BINARY bytes become a product requirement.

entries.tinygrad: No language-neutral Polygrad bundle equivalent
entries.polygrad: IR, bundle, safetensors, and named Instance export/import
entries.rationale: Portable packaging is an intentional Polygrad superset feature.

entries.tinygrad: Pinned two-i32 lowering fails for dynamic uint32 shift counts and signed SHR
entries.polygrad: Two-i32 lowering preserves valid dynamic counts and arithmetic signed SHR, plus the existing raw-C i32,i32 to i64 superset case
entries.rationale: This is a correctness-preserving backend superset over a pinned tinygrad failure.
entries.close_when: Re-evaluate when the pinned tinygrad behavior changes.

entries.tinygrad: Python GC and weak references own Tensor/UOp wrapper lifetime
entries.polygrad: C arenas and explicit frontend owner hooks own core objects
entries.rationale: C object ownership cannot be identical to Python GC; semantic graph lifetime must still satisfy the parity and capture gates.

entries.tinygrad: Tensor.uop already contains occurrence-specific executable placement when realization begins
entries.polygrad: Default realization consumes the eagerly constructed physical graph directly; explicit placement starts from logical roots plus exact named resource bindings and never consumes a prior physical graph
entries.rationale: Path B removed placement and logical fallback from default realization. The legacy Tensor physicalizer, logical-and-device memo, and runtime-residency AUTO inference are deleted; incomplete raw physical roots fail before callify.

resolution.evidence: Default physical topology, occurrence, mutation, rebuilt-subexpression, JIT, Instance, and broad frontend/backend gates pass without realization-time placement or logical-key correspondence. Explicit aggregate place starts from logical roots and exact resource bindings; raw scheduling rejects device-free storage regardless of attached residency.

entries.tinygrad: Variables are PARAM(STACK(), ParamArg(slot=-1, name, vmin_vmax, AddrSpace.ALU))
entries.polygrad: Variables use BUFFER/PARAM with ParamArg AddrSpace.ALU; binding uses AFTER(variable, STORE(variable, value))
entries.rationale: This is shared IR vocabulary debt, not an approved divergence.

resolution.evidence: Removed DEFINE_VAR/BIND and their argument carrier from the C IR, serialization, symbolic passes, scheduler, rangeify, renderers, and tests. Exact symbolic, callify, runtime scalar, and JIT regressions use current BUFFER/PARAM/AFTER+STORE topology.

entries.tinygrad: BUFFER with ParamArg addrspace REG or LOCAL represents compiler storage
entries.polygrad: BUFFER with ParamArg addrspace REG or LOCAL represents compiler storage
entries.rationale: Historical vocabulary debt is closed; resolved rows preserve the audit trail.

resolution.evidence: Removed DEFINE_LOCAL/DEFINE_REG from the C op enum, renderers, interpreter, compiler helpers, and tests; current BUFFER(REG/LOCAL) remains.

entries.tinygrad: Vector constants are STACKs of scalar CONST sources
entries.polygrad: Vector constants use STACKs of scalar CONST sources
entries.rationale: This is shared IR topology debt.

resolution.evidence: Removed VCONST from the C IR, symbolic passes, placement, Instance validation, codegen, renderers, and tests; current vector constants use STACK(CONST, ...).

entries.tinygrad: Storage views retain exact SHRINK/BITCAST UOps while Buffer.view owns base/offset runtime state
entries.polygrad: Exact SHRINK/BITCAST UOps now key the same non-owning runtime view metadata
entries.rationale: This is shared storage/view vocabulary debt; it is not the approved deviceless logical graph divergence.

resolution.evidence: Removed the synthetic UOp and constructor; callification retains exact movement UOps while ctx buffer metadata owns aliases.

entries.tinygrad: Tensor graphs use REDUCE with axes encoded in the UOp argument
entries.polygrad: All reduction construction and import use REDUCE with (op, num_axes); REDUCE_AXIS is deleted
entries.rationale: The extra enum is not an approved permanent shared-IR divergence.

resolution.evidence: REDUCE_AXIS and its separate argument carrier were removed from enum, UOp identity, shape inference, symbolic ordering, rendering, IR, realization, and tests; current REDUCE topology gates pass.

entries.tinygrad: RESHAPE/EXPAND use shape-value sources, PAD/SHRINK use start/size shape-value sources, PERMUTE keeps its permutation tuple, and FLIP keeps a rank-sized boolean-mask tuple
entries.polygrad: Tensor construction now uses the same source and argument topology for RESHAPE, EXPAND, PAD, SHRINK, PERMUTE, and FLIP
entries.rationale: This was shared Tensor IR topology debt and was closed by the movement-vocabulary port.

resolution.evidence: Exact tensor-stage PAD/SHRINK/PERMUTE/FLIP corpus passed with zero findings; native, Python, JS native, and JS WASM gates passed.

entries.tinygrad: WAIT and GETADDR participate in current multi-device scheduling/lowering
entries.polygrad: WAIT and GETADDR are absent
entries.rationale: Unused-for-HLB vocabulary remains deferred parity debt, not an approved difference.
entries.close_when: WS6 ports their construction and lowering with pinned multi-device probes.

entries.tinygrad: Range propagation collects all consumers
entries.polygrad: A fixed 16-consumer collection cap silently forces realization
entries.rationale: The cap can change schedule topology and must grow dynamically or fail loudly.
entries.close_when: More-than-16-consumer realize sets and schedules match pinned tinygrad.

entries.tinygrad: PCONTIG enables partial-axis realization on multi-consumer disagreement
entries.polygrad: Default whole-axis behavior exists, but enabled PCONTIG behavior is absent
entries.rationale: Default PCONTIG=0 is aligned; the non-default control remains parity debt.
entries.close_when: Default and enabled-PCONTIG axis probes match pinned tinygrad.

entries.tinygrad: Changed EXPAND ranges add the symbolic guarded ranges closure to ending ranges
entries.polygrad: Current path appends raw changed output-range values without the complete symbolic closure
entries.rationale: This can alter realization topology on symbolic EXPAND graphs.
entries.close_when: Symbolic EXPAND ending-range traces match pinned tinygrad.

entries.tinygrad: WINO=1 selects the implemented Winograd 3x3 convolution path
entries.polygrad: The Python ContextVar exists but has no corresponding core implementation
entries.rationale: Frontend name parity without behavior is not complete API parity.
entries.close_when: WINO=0 and WINO=1 source/probe behavior is parity-aligned across required frontends/backends.

entries.tinygrad: Device strings distinguish instances such as CUDA:0 and CUDA:1
entries.polygrad: Closed PolyDevice enum identifies only backend classes
entries.rationale: This blocks true same-backend multi-device placement.
entries.close_when: Device identity is backend plus instance and multi-device construction/lowering passes.

entries.tinygrad: Current bounded HLB-style train comparator captures 20 LINEAR CALLs
entries.polygrad: The same comparator now captures 20 LINEAR CALLs
entries.rationale: The former four-call delta came from high-level SUB, EXP/LOG, reduction accumulation, and softmax/log-softmax topology rather than optimizer or Rangeify behavior. C-owned construction now follows pinned tinygrad and closes the bounded schedule mismatch.

resolution.evidence: The permanent graph oracle passes 69/69 with zero suppressions; isolated model backward is 8/8 CALLs and bounded HLB train/eval/eval-EMA/EMA is 20/8/8/3 in both engines with maximum value error 5.96046448e-08.

entries.tinygrad: Assignment is AFTER(target, STORE(target, value)); current Ops has no ASSIGN member
entries.polygrad: All assignment construction uses AFTER(target, STORE(target, value)); ASSIGN is deleted
entries.rationale: Two live spellings for the same mutation semantics prevent exact graph parity and make the moved/view mutation gate ambiguous.

resolution.evidence: ASSIGN was removed from shared IR, autograd, placement, rangeify, realization, serialization, and raw tests; mutation gates use AFTER/STORE.

entries.tinygrad: Current Ops has no ENCDEC member
entries.polygrad: ENCDEC is absent from the op vocabulary and compiler paths
entries.rationale: Near-dead vocabulary must be proved unreachable and removed or registered as an approved product boundary; silence is not parity.

resolution.evidence: ENCDEC and its rangeify/schedule guards were deleted; the runtime op census no longer reports it.

entries.tinygrad: Current Ops has no INVALID member and cannot construct or import it as a UOp
entries.polygrad: Enum slot zero has no public name and PGIR rejects it before UOp construction
entries.rationale: An internal sentinel must not be accepted as public graph vocabulary.

resolution.evidence: poly_op_name(0) returns no public op and current-version PGIR with op zero is rejected before construction.

entries.area: unsigned maximum constants and scatter amin
entries.tinygrad: Unsigned inverse/minimum use an exact positive dtype.max CONST and scatter amin reduces with inverse/MAX/inverse
entries.polygrad: Unsigned inverse/minimum use the exact positive dtype.max argument, and scatter amin reduces with the same inverse/MAX/inverse topology and zero-sensitive values
entries.rationale: The exact integer carrier closes both the graph-argument debt and the reachable unsigned scatter-amin value bug without a dtype-local surrogate.

resolution.evidence: Unsigned minimum has zero graph findings for uint8/16/32/64. Scatter amin contains the exact positive maximum and inverse/MAX/inverse reducer, has no unary NEG, and returns [[0,100]] for every width.

entries.tinygrad: Numeric host values are staged as numeric source values and converted to the requested dtype in the Tensor graph
entries.polygrad: JavaScript plain numeric arrays requested as float16 are flattened through Uint16Array, so numeric values are reinterpreted as half storage bits before graph construction
entries.rationale: The current route corrupts input before elementwise execution; operations must not compensate for invalid host staging.
entries.close_when: Plain JavaScript numeric float16 arrays encode pinned direct-buffer storage without a frontend CAST across native, Wasm, and browser frontends; backend readback matches the corresponding Tinygrad renderer, including the PythonRenderer non-native-half subnormal boundary.

entries.tinygrad: Non-truncating symbolic constant folding stores arbitrary-precision Python integers in CONST args, including results above INT64_MAX
entries.polygrad: PolyArg stores canonical exact signed integers outside int64 as immutable base-2^32 magnitudes; symbolic folding keeps Python-style exact results and fixed-width renderers truncate only at their backend boundary
entries.rationale: This closes the former carrier debt with the same semantic boundary as tinygrad rather than suppressing or locally special-casing high-bit constants.

resolution.evidence: Direct, associative, distributive, unary, ternary, weakint-vector, high-bit chained-shift, and large-divisor graphs match pinned tinygrad. Exact C/interpreter, WebGPU long decomposition, CUDA render/runtime, Wasm runtime, IR-v4 round-trip, RNG, and float64x2 SIN gates pass; the full ASan/UBSan/LSan native matrix is 1422/1422.

entries.tinygrad: _pre_scatter constructs shrink, unsqueeze/expand/transpose, one-hot, and pad_to graphs with three retained PAD nodes in the focused rank-two case
entries.polygrad: The same focused amax/amin values pass, but the shared pre-scatter graph has one PAD plus additional EXPAND, RESHAPE, CMPNE, WHERE, and one fewer STACK node
entries.rationale: This whole-graph construction mismatch affects amax and amin equally and remains after the unsigned maximum/reducer bug is closed; it is not an approved divergence.
entries.close_when: Focused rank-two and generalized scatter/scatter-reduce construction graphs match pinned tinygrad for shrink, one-hot, transpose, pad_to, include_self, and all five reducers without suppressions.

entries.tinygrad: UOp.contiguous returns the original UOp when device is None
entries.polygrad: Tensor.contiguous has the exact device-free fold, but raw poly_contiguous still creates a CONTIGUOUS barrier for device-free graphs consumed by preserved legacy logical builders
entries.rationale: Changing the overloaded raw helper before those builders migrate removes deliberate pre-placement materialization barriers. The default Tensor parity surface must remain exact while the legacy raw/import route stays visible as migration debt.
entries.close_when: All executable raw/import callers carry complete physical device facts or cross explicit place, the device-free fold moves into poly_contiguous itself, and the native realization matrix remains green.

entries.tinygrad: Python source tuples have no uint16 ceiling; pm_add_control_flow can append a predecessor to a 65,535-source RANGE and produce 65,536 sources
entries.polygrad: PolyUOp.n_src is uint16_t; poly_apply_control_flow now fails the whole pass cleanly at that exact boundary instead of returning a partial graph
entries.rationale: The existing C representation cannot encode the pinned result. Clean failure is required for correctness but is not approval of the parity debt or permission to widen the UOp representation implicitly.
entries.close_when: A separately approved arity representation migration carries every UOp/CSE/IR/ABI consumer beyond uint16 and the 65,536-source result matches pinned tinygrad, or the accepted public graph contract explicitly rejects the input before construction.

entries.tinygrad: PYLITERAL carries immutable Python literals used by compiled UPat CUSTOM predicates
entries.polygrad: The C pattern compiler has no PYLITERAL UOp or equivalent current compiled-UPat topology
entries.rationale: This is August pattern/compiler vocabulary debt, not an approved semantic divergence.
entries.close_when: The dependency-closed UPat/SPEC migration either ports PYLITERAL with exact compiled-pattern topology or proves the C representation uses the same semantics without exposing a different shared UOp vocabulary.
